title: Awakening LLMs’ Reasoning Potential: A Fine-Grained Pipeline to Evaluate and Mitigate Vague Perception

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the inclination of large language models to unnecessarily output 'unknown' (abstain) on objectively solvable reasoning tasks, quantified through a two-stage stimulation pipeline that measures the Unknown Converting Rate (UCR).

Testing Label Conformity and Reasoning Process Conformity by deliberately providing models with randomly assigned incorrect labels or flawed previous reasoning traces to observe if they replicate and agree with the misguidance.
